title: Balochistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Amendment Act 2007

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Amendment Act 2007
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2007
ACT III OF 2007
BALOCHISTAN
GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND
TRAINING INSTITUTIONS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2007
An Act further to amend
the Balochistan Government
Educational and Training
Institution
Ordinance 1960 (XI of
1960)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary
14th June, 2007]
No. PAB/Legis:V
(40)/2007, dated 14-6-2007.---The Balochistan
Government Educational and Training Institutions (Amendment) Bill No.4 of 2007
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan
on 2nd June, 2007 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, on 5th June, 2007, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to further amend the Balochistan
Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance 1960 (XI of 1960) in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Balochistan Government Educational
and Training Institutions (Amendment) Act, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
